_comment: T-31 0.2.8: pin of the default avatar (restrictive asset, NOT in this repo, NOT AGPL). The .vrm is never committed (*.vrm is gitignored). scripts/lib/default-vrm.cjs copies it (from ZUMI_DEFAULT_VRM_PATH, else the owner values' defaultAvatarSource in src/main/owner-values.json) into <resources>/models at build time (afterPack) after checking size + sha256 here, and FAILS the build if it is missing or different. src/main/default-model.js pins the same sha256 at runtime; scripts/check-default-model.mjs asserts the two agree.
